200.description:
Current beneficial owners of Latvian legal entities (beneficial_owners.csv, ~200k rows), paged through the CKAN datastore in `_id` order. Each page re-reads the resource's `last_modified` and compares it, and the row total, with the publication pinned in the cursor; a mismatch is `invalid_input` with issue code `publication_changed` (restart from the first page). Rows map to the shared owner schema: `source_record_id` = `lv:<id>`, `owner_kind` = person, `nationalities` from `nationality`, `notified_on` from `registered_on`; `ceased_on` and `natures_of_control` are not published.

The response contains the tool result directly.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Share ownership of one company for percent-of-capital context: SIA members (members.csv) and AS stockholders (stockholders.csv) filtered by `at_legal_entity_registration_number`, with `number_of_shares`, nominal value, currency and (stockholders) votes. The company is first resolved in register.csv: an unknown registration number is `not_found`; a known company with no published holdings is a successful empty result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `company_name` | string | Name from register.csv. |
| `company_registration_number` | string | Register of Enterprises registration number as published (11 digits for Latvian entities). |
| `file_urls` | object |  |
| `holdings` | object[] | Members first, then stockholders, each in `_id` order. |
| `legal_form_code` | string |  |
| `members_total` | number | Rows in members.csv for this company (exact). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the call finished. |
| `publications` | object |  |
| `retrieved_at` | string | When this record was fetched, UTC ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`). |
